title: Straighter teeth with aligners
lead: Example teeth, not yours. Clear aligners move teeth a little at a time; how long it takes depends on the person.

steps.label: Start
steps.words: Clear trays made for the teeth are worn most of the day and night.

steps.label: Around month 3
steps.words: Each new set of trays moves the teeth a little further.

steps.label: Around month 9
steps.words: The teeth are lining up and the gaps are closing.

steps.label: Finishing
steps.words: The trays stop once the teeth and bite are where planned.

steps.label: Retainer
steps.words: A retainer keeps the teeth in their new place.
